The main takeaway from our work is that
domain adaptation can be performed in an unsupervised way without the need of any additional training data from the source domain.
domain invariant latent feature representation can be achieved by metric based regularization of a neural network, which is a simple yet effective way to achieve robust unsupervised domain adaption.
